links.outcome: Concordance of ChatGPT-4o recommendation with final MTB decision versus protocol benchmark
links.effect: High concordance for recommendation 79.2% (95% CI, 70.6-85.9), below the ≥80% benchmark; no attitude change (0/106); added value 13.2%
links.quote: High concordance was 91.5% (summarisation), 84.0% (reasoning) and 79.2% (recommendation; 95% CI, 70.6-85.9), below benchmark (Friedman χ2 = 34.756; p < 0.001; κ = 0.618).

links.outcome: Model errors documented in AI outputs, including among highly concordant outputs
links.effect: Model errors in 19/106 discussions (17.9%), including 13/84 (15.5%) rated highly concordant and 6/22 (27.3%) rated below threshold; four errors (3.8%) potentially harmful
links.quote: The post hoc review documented model errors in 19/106 discussions (17.9%), including 13/84 (15.5%) discussions rated highly concordant and 6/22 (27.3%) rated below that threshold; four errors (3.8%) were graded as potentially harmful.

links.outcome: Prospective performance of AI with outputs hidden from decision-makers until after consensus
links.effect: Outputs revealed only after MTB consensus; recommendation concordance 79.2%, below benchmark; four potentially harmful errors identified without affecting decisions (0/106 attitude change)
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o produced a guideline-informed decision with rationale from de-identified summaries, revealed only after MTB consensus.

screen.reason: Prospective evaluation (in silent/parallel mode during live multidisciplinary tumour boards) of ChatGPT-4o decision support compared against clinician consensus; assesses model accuracy and concordance without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
